anomalies.observed: On the Main Pump driver, the gate-pull resistor R5 (10 k) is wired from the T2 (IRLR2905) gate node up to the +3V3 rail (the +3V3 global arrow sits directly above R5), so the low-side N-MOS gate is pulled HIGH when the pre-driver T1 is off. The structurally identical ATO-valve driver on the same sheet instead ties its gate-pull resistor R12 (10 k) to GND.
anomalies.expected: A low-side N-MOS switch gate must be pulled down to GND so the load is default-OFF and only turns on when the MCU drives the gate high (as the ATO valve correctly does with R12 to GND). The spec describes T2 as a 'Main circulation-pump low-side switch... gate driven through R1 (100 Ω) from the ESP32 pin, pre-driven via T1' with no pull-up to a supply rail.

evidence.quote: sheet 1, Main Pump tile: '+3V3' arrow -> R5 10k -> T2 gate node (Drain); T2 IRLR2905 source pin 2 -> GND; R1 100R from PUMP_MAIN to same gate node; T1 BT3904 collector to gate node
sheet 1, ATO Valve tile (for comparison): R12 10k from T5 gate node -> GND (ground symbol at bottom), T5 AO3400A source -> GND

T2 — IRLR2905 (DPAK N-MOSFET) | Main circulation-pump low-side switch | Netlist: drives PUMP_MAIN net to the 24 V main pump load; gate driven through R1 (100 Ω) from the ESP32 pin, pre-driven via T1 (BT3904 NPN level shifter).

anomalies.impact: The main circulation pump is default-ON / inverted: whenever the low-water float interlock is not actively pulling the gate down (T1 off) and PUMP_MAIN is not driven low, R5 holds the gate at +3V3 and the pump energizes — including at MCU boot or if the GPIO is left high-impedance. The firmware's active-high 'main pump switch' cannot turn the pump off by going idle, defeating software control and creating an unintended continuous-run hazard.

parsed.summary: Anomaly detected: the main-pump low-side MOSFET (T2) has its gate-pull resistor R5 connected to +3V3 instead of GND, making the pump default-ON/inverted, in contrast to the correctly pulled-down ATO-valve driver (R12 to GND); this is a wiring error that would cause the circulation pump to run whenever the float interlock is not forcing it off.
